app.name: SprintMasası
app.tagline: Fun, fair sprint planning with your team. No account, just a link.

cards.title: Cards flip together
cards.text: Everyone votes face down. When the dealer reveals, the spread, average and outliers show up on the table.

assign.title: Who takes it?
assign.text: No volunteer? A horse race or a wheel decides, and the server picks the winner fairly.

tickets.title: Ticket queue
tickets.text: Work through a ticket list if you like; final estimates and assignees stay in the session history.

create.title: New room
create.name: Room name
create.passwordHint: Leave empty and anyone with the link can join. Add one if your ticket titles are confidential.
create.ticketsHint: While off, the table plays free rounds; the dealer can turn it on any time in settings.

decks.title: Deck
decks.customHint: Up to 20 cards, up to 8 characters each, no duplicates.
decks.changeHint: Changing the deck resets this round's votes and everyone is notified.
decks.changeConfirm: If the deck changes, the votes cast in this round will be deleted. Continue?

error.tooMany: A deck can have at most 20 cards.

join.title: Join the room
join.nicknamePlaceholder: How should your teammates see you?
join.observer: Join as an observer (watch without voting)
join.renamed: That name was already taken, so you joined as “{{name}}”.
join.takeoverQuestion: The seat “{{name}}” is empty at the table. Is it yours?
join.takeoverHint: If you take it over you return to the same seat, avatar and this round's vote. The dealer role is not taken over.

room.closeConfirm: The room will be closed and deleted for everyone. Are you sure?
room.kickConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the table? Their unrevealed vote is deleted; they can rejoin with the link.

gone.notFoundBody: This room may have been closed, expired, or the server may have restarted.
gone.expiredBody: The room was closed because it was unused for a long time.
gone.kickedTitle: You were removed from the table
gone.kickedBody: The dealer removed you from the table. You can rejoin with the room link if you like.

errors.INVALID_PASSWORD: The password can be at most 64 characters.
errors.PASSWORD_REQUIRED: This room is password-protected, please enter the password.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: Your session is invalid, please join again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Only the dealer can do this.
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong attempts. Wait a bit and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Slow down a little, let the table breathe.
errors.SERVER_BUSY: The server is very busy right now and cannot open new rooms. Please try again shortly.
errors.INVALID_DECK: Invalid deck: at most 20 cards, at most 8 characters per card, no duplicates.
errors.INVALID_TICKET: Invalid ticket: the title must be 1-120 characters and the link must start with http(s).
errors.WRONG_PHASE: This cannot be done right now (the round state changed).
errors.ALREADY_VOTED: You have voted; take back your vote first to become an observer.
errors.TICKET_LIMIT: A room can have at most 100 tickets.
errors.FEATURE_DISABLED: The ticket list is turned off in this room.
errors.NO_VOTES: Nobody has voted yet, so the cards cannot be revealed.
errors.SEAT_TAKEOVER: There is an empty seat with this name.
errors.KICKED: The dealer removed you from the table.

poker.handHint: Pick a card (←/→ or number keys, Enter to confirm). Click the selected card again to take back your vote.
poker.handLocked: Cards are revealed. You can vote again when a new round starts.
poker.observerNote: You are an observer: you follow the table without voting.
poker.noVotesYet: At least one vote is needed to reveal the cards
poker.deckChangedToast: The deck changed, this round's votes were reset.
poker.nudgedYou: 👉 The dealer nudged you: the table is waiting for your vote.
poker.breakTimeSub: Most votes are the break card.
poker.dealerPicksFinal: The dealer picks the final estimate.
poker.discussTip: Highest was {{high}}, lowest {{low}}. Hear their reasons and vote again.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.emptyModerator: No tickets yet. You can add some below.
tickets.addPlaceholder:
ABC-12 Login page https://…
ABC-13 Password reset
tickets.addHint: One ticket per line. A link on the line becomes the ticket's link.
tickets.enableHint: When on, a ticket queue appears next to the table.
tickets.disableHint: If you turn it off the tickets are hidden, not deleted; they return when you turn it on again.

assign.title: Who takes it?
assign.volunteerLead: Whoever wants the work says “I'll take it”.
assign.volunteerRules: With a single volunteer the work goes to them. With none, everyone who voted is a candidate.
assign.fairRotationHint: Anyone who already took work in this session has their chance halved each time.
assign.waitingDealer: The dealer is choosing candidates and the game…
assign.byVolunteer: They were the only volunteer, no game was played.
assign.volunteerSub: Whoever wants the work says “I'll take it”; anyone who doesn't can pass.
assign.fairNote: Fair rotation is on: anyone who took work earlier has their chance halved.
assign.directSub: There is a single candidate, so no game is played.
assign.fairSub: Those who took work earlier have a lower chance.
assign.winsNone: has not taken any in this session
assign.serverDecides: The server picks the winner; nobody can influence the game.

gameNote.horse: Candidates run, whoever finishes first takes it.
gameNote.wheel: The wheel spins, whoever the arrow stops on takes it.

assign.watchTogether: Everyone watches at the same time.
assign.wheelSub: Whoever the arrow stops on takes it.
assign.sameRace: Everyone sees the same race at the same time.
assign.nextHalf: Next time their chance is halved.
assign.assignAndNext: Assign and go to the next

settings.autoRevealHint: Cards flip on their own once everyone has voted.
settings.fairHint: Anyone who already took work has their chance halved each time.
settings.volunteerHint: How long (in seconds) to wait for volunteers when “Who takes it?” opens.
settings.ticketsOffHint: When on, a ticket queue appears next to the table.
settings.passwordHint: Leave empty to keep it unchanged.
settings.passwordSet: A password is set; typing a new one replaces it.
settings.closeHint: The room closes and is deleted for everyone.
